notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1.8
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.8 is now live.

- Just a minor patch to fix some UI issues with the server browser.

Please look out for an announcement about our new game tomorrow!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1.7
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.7 is now live.

- Portuguese (Brazilian) translation added

As always, thanks for your support and Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.6 is now live.

- Improved performance when running on higher graphic settings
- Improved mouse input smoothing when turning
- FOV defaults to 60 for new players

As always, thanks for your support and Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.5 is now live.

- Arabic is now rendered correctly in RTL format. It's not perfect but it should now be fully readable.

Please note that we have some plans for version 1.2.0 to improve the game as soon as we launch DEVOUR first (Jan 2021).

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.4 is now live.

- Arabic translation added. This is currently rendered LTR but in our next major patch we will attempt to render RTL.

Please note that we have some plans for version 1.2.0 to improve the game as soon as we launch DEVOUR first (Jan 2021).

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Thanks for your feedback! Version 1.1.3 is now live.

- Fix to prevent an exploitative method of solving Mask.
- Added a noticeable clue to find the most well hidden rose.
- West corridor stairs improved to prevent rare cases of getting stuck and falling through the world.
- Fix to prevent cultist from clipping through a wall near servants hall.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
We've listened to your feedback and made a few changes in our first post-release patch, v1.1.2.


 Improves Mask puzzle
 Fixes an issue where AI would sometimes see at an unintended angle
 Improves Japanese translation
 Fixes placement of Reset button in the keybinding UI

notes.title: Patch Notes: AI and server improvements
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has played The Watchers since the release. We've listened to your feedback and made a few changes in our first post-release patch, v1.1.1.


 Matchmaking improvements made by adding several new server regions
 Added Hint system. If you want, you can now get 1 hint for each object.
 Cultists have a lower detection radius for crouched footsteps
 Adjusted the audio effects for crouched footsteps
 Allow easier escape when leaving the Courtyard whilst carrying the Bowl
 Added a window to last part of Shoes puzzle to spot the Cultist in the closet easier
 Prevents "tap" moving behind the cultist in the Reading Room for the Ritual Book puzzle
 Steam Invites now work even if your server is password-protected
 Invert Mouse option added to settings
 A few object placement and lighting improvements
